description: Animations in an AnimationPlayer and states in an AnimationTree state machine. read answers with every track of an animation in the shape add_track takes, so a track read off one animation can be added to another. read and read_states need no editor: one serving the project answers and says whether it holds unsaved changes to the scene, and with none a headless engine reads the file without running the scene's scripts. The ops that write go through the editor when one serves the project; with none, a headless engine runs the editor's own tool and the answer says so under writtenBy. That engine runs every script of the file, where the editor runs only tool scripts, so what a script changes as the file loads is put back before anything is saved, and a file where that cannot be done, such as a scene whose script does not compile, is refused and nothing is written. An editor of the project that is running and has not reached this server is waited for rather than written around. Operations: read (needs playerNodePath): the animations of an AnimationPlayer, or one with its tracks; read_states (needs animTreePath): the states and transitions of an AnimationTree state machine; create (needs playerNodePath, animationName): a new animation in an AnimationPlayer; add_track (needs playerNodePath, animationName, track): a property or method track with keyframes; add_state (needs animTreePath, stateName, animationName): a state playing an animation, in an AnimationTree; connect_states (needs animTreePath, fromState, toState): a transition between two states.

advanceCondition.description: connect_states: the condition parameter that advances. Only for op connect_states.

animTreePath.description: The AnimationTree node. Only for ops read_states, add_state, connect_states.

animationName.description: The animation in the player. read: the one to answer with whole, its tracks a list; without it, read lists them, each with the number of its tracks under tracks. add_state: the one that state plays. Only for ops read, create, add_track, add_state.

fromState.description: connect_states: the state the transition leaves. Only for op connect_states.

length.description: create: seconds. Default 1. Only for op create.

loopMode.description: create: default none. Only for op create.

playerNodePath.description: The AnimationPlayer node. Only for ops read, create, add_track.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scenePath.description: Scene file inside the project, such as "scenes/main.tscn" or "res://scenes/main.tscn".

stateMachinePath.description: A nested state machine, by the names of the states that lead to it. Default the root. Only for ops read_states, add_state, connect_states.

stateName.description: add_state: the state to add. It goes right of the rightmost state in the editor's graph, answered under position. Only for op add_state.

step.description: create: keyframe snap in seconds. Default 0.1. Only for op create.

toState.description: connect_states: the state it arrives at. Only for op connect_states.

track.description: The track to add. Only for op add_track.

args.description: For method tracks: the arguments to call with.

value.description: For property tracks: the value at this time.

method.description: For method tracks: the method to call. The answer's methodFound says whether the target node has it; a method it lacks is still added, since it may be written next, and until it exists each call the track makes fails.

nodePath.description: Target node, relative to the AnimationPlayer root.

property.description: For property tracks: the property to animate.

transitionType.description: connect_states: default immediate. Only for op connect_states.

name: scene_animation
title: Animations
